title: Drop-Ship Merchandise in Ship-To Service Level Reviews
content:
Drop-ship merchandise of a Ship-To Fulfillment Account — order lines Corbett has the manufacturer ship direct — does not always count in full at the ship-to's anniversary service level review.

**Rule.** Drop-ship merchandise, the extended amount of shipped order lines shipped by manufacturer drop ship, counts at a share set by its weight in the ship-to's shipped merchandise of the last 12 months: where it is more than 25 percent of the extended amount of all the ship-to's shipped order lines of the 12 months it counts at 0 percent; where it is above 0.00 and at most 25 percent it counts at 50 percent; otherwise it counts in full.

**Effect.** Where drop-ship merchandise counts at a share below full, the part that does not count is taken out of the twelve-month spend and out of the six-month spend of the review, each over its own months: the drop-ship merchandise of the 12 months for the twelve-month spend and the drop-ship merchandise of the 6 months for the six-month spend, both at the one share set by the 12-month weight.

### Weight and share

The weight compares the drop-ship merchandise of the 12 months with the extended amount of all shipped order lines of the same 12 months (backorder fill lines are not shipped order lines and are in neither amount). A line is within N months when fewer than N whole months separate its date from the review date.

| Drop-ship merchandise of the 12 months | Share counted | Part taken out |
|---|---|---|
| more than 25 percent of all shipped merchandise of the 12 months | 0 percent | all of it |
| above 0.00 and at most 25 percent | 50 percent | half of it |
| 0.00 | in full | none |

Boundary (hypothetical): with all shipped merchandise of 16000.00, drop-ship merchandise of exactly 4000.00 is 25 percent and counts at 50 percent; 4000.01 is more than 25 percent and counts at 0 percent.

### Worked figure (hypothetical)

All shipped merchandise of the 12 months 40000.00, of which drop-ship 4000.00 (10 percent): drop-ship counts at 50 percent, so 2000.00 is taken out of the twelve-month spend. Drop-ship lines within the 6 months total 1500.00, so 750.00 is taken out of the six-month spend.
